decisions.reason: The LED ceiling luminaire builds directly on the firm's core design, planning-tool and dealer knowledge, so it can interpret early results and keep refining the line rather than withdraw it.
The flexible LED spotlight line is close to the established spotlight competence, so the firm can learn from its first year and assimilate lessons from the withdrawn track spotlight to improve it.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy extends the modular system logic the firm already masters and supports system sales, so its value is easy to recognise and keep developing.
The low-voltage canopy builds on existing system and electrical know-how, and its fit with the modular offer lets the firm adapt it on the basis of installer feedback.

The round glass track luminaires are close to the core design offer, but their weaker website presence signals limited visibility, so the withdrawal risk is higher, though related knowledge still argues for keeping and improving them.
